1.word_for_word: त्रि-युक्-षष्टितमे चाथ बाण-यादव-सङ्गरे । — In the sixty-third yuk, there was a battle between Bāṇa and the Yadavas.; स्तुतिर् ज्वरेण रुद्रेण बाण-बाहुमिदो हरेः ॥१॥ — Praise to the feverish Rudra, the arrow-armed Hari.
1.translation: In the sixty-third yuk, there was a battle between Bāṇa and the Yadavas. Praise to the feverish Rudra, the arrow-armed Hari.

2.word_for_word: कर्म च युद्धादिकम् ॥२॥ — and action, such as war.

3.word_for_word: राम-कृष्णानुवर्तिन इति तौ पुरतो निर्गताव् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३॥ — This means that they followed Rama and Krishna and went out in front of them.
3.translation: This means that they followed Rama and Krishna and went out in front of them.

4.word_for_word: सर्वतो-दिशम् इत्य् अस्योत्तरेणान्वयः ॥४॥ — The consequence of this is that it is in all directions.
4.translation: The consequence of this is that it is in all directions.

5.word_for_word: भज्यमानानि पुरोद्यानादीनि । — The gardens and other places are being destroyed.; द्वन्द्वैकवद् भावः । — It feels like a duality.; अट्टालाः प्राकाराद् उपरितनान्य् उन्नत-स्थानानि । — Attics are elevated places above the walls.; अभिनिर्ययौ बाणः ॥५॥ — The arrow went out.
5.translation: The gardens and other places are being destroyed. It feels like a duality. Attics are elevated places above the walls. The arrow went out.

6.word_for_word: सुतः स्कन्दस् तत् सहितैः प्रमथैर् गणैः । — The son of Skanda, along with the hosts of the Pramathas,; राम-कृष्णाभ्यां युयुधे ॥६-१२॥ — He fought with Rama and Krishna (6-12).
6.translation: The son of Skanda, along with the hosts of the Pramathas, He fought with Rama and Krishna (6-12).

13.word_for_word: प्रत्य् अस्त्राण्य् एवाह---ब्रह्मास्त्रस्येति । — He said of the weapons of the Brahmastra.; नैजं नारायणास्त्रम् ॥१३-१४॥ — It is not the weapon of Narayana.13-1
13.translation: He said of the weapons of the Brahmastra. It is not the weapon of Narayana.13-1

15.word_for_word: शिखिना मयूरेण वाहनेन ॥१५॥ — The peacock was carried by a peacock.
15.translation: The peacock was carried by a peacock.

16.word_for_word: तयोर् अनीकानि । — There are many of them.; हती नाथी येषां तानि ॥१६॥ — They are the ones whose master is killed.
16.translation: There are many of them. They are the ones whose master is killed.

21.word_for_word: अनिरीक्षमाणस् तिर्यङ्मुखो बभूवेति ॥२१॥ — Without looking at him he turned his face to the animal.
21.translation: Without looking at him he turned his face to the animal.

22.word_for_word: ज्वरस् तु योद्धुम् अभ्यधावद् इति ॥२२॥ — The fever, however, rushed to fight.
22.translation: The fever, however, rushed to fight.

23.word_for_word: श्री-नारायणः शीत-ज्वरमसृजत ॥२३॥ — Sri-Narayana created a cold fever.

24.word_for_word: माहेश्वरः समाक्रण्दन् युयुधे ॥२४॥ — Maheswara fought with a loud cry.
24.translation: Maheswara fought with a loud cry.

25.word_for_word: आत्मानं परम-शक्तिमन्तं मन्यमानः श्री-कृष्णं तापयितुं प्रवृत्तः स्वयम् एव तप्तः सन्, तं परमेश्वरं ज्ञात्वा स्तुवन् नमस्करोति---नमामीति । — Considering himself to be supremely powerful, he begins to heat Lord Kṛṣṇa, and when he himself is heated, he recognizes Him as God and bows down to Him in praise.; त्वा त्वाम् अनन्त-शक्तिं नमामि । — I bow to You, You, the Infinite Power.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; परेषां ब्रह्मादीनाम् ईशम् । — He is the Lord of others, such as Brahmā.; तत्र हेतुः---सर्वात्मानं सर्वस्यात्मानं चेतयितारम् । — The reason for this is that the Supreme Soul is the consciousness of the Supreme Soul of all.; तत् कुतः ? — Where is that from?; केवलं शुद्धम् । — It’s just pure.; ज्ञप्ति-मात्रं चैतन्य-घनम् । — Knowledge alone is dense with consciousness.; तद् एवं सर्व-चेतयितृत्वेन परमेश्वरत्वम् उक्तम् । — That is thus said to be the Supreme Being as the all-consciousness.; किं च, विश्व-सृष्ट्य्-आदि-हेतुत्वाद् अपीत्य् आह---विश्वोत्पत्तीति । — Moreover, since it is also the cause of the creation of the universe, he argues that it is the origin of the universe.; नन्व् एवं-भूतं ब्रह्म प्रसिद्धं नाहम् इति तत्राह---यत् तद् ब्रह्मेति । — If, however, the Brahman thus existing is not known as I, then he argues that whatever is Brahman is Brahman.; यद् ब्रह्म तद् एव त्वम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that whatever is Brahman is what you are.; किं तद् ब्रह्म ? — What is that Brahman?; इत्य् अत आह---ब्रह्म-लिङ्गं ब्रह्मणा वेदेन लिङ्ग्यते द्योत्य् अत इति । — It is therefore argued that the Brahman-lingam is signified by the Brahman and the Vedas, and therefore it is illustrated.; तत् कुतः ? — Where is that from?; प्रशान्तम्, सर्व-विक्रिया-रहितत्वान् न साक्षाद् वाच्यम् इति भावः ॥२५॥ — This means that it is peaceful, devoid of all reactions, and cannot be directly expressed.
25.translation: Considering himself to be supremely powerful, he begins to heat Lord Kṛṣṇa, and when he himself is heated, he recognizes Him as God and bows down to Him in praise. I bow to You, You, the Infinite Power. Where is it from? He is the Lord of others, such as Brahmā. The reason for this is that the Supreme Soul is the consciousness of the Supreme Soul of all. Where is that from? It’s just pure. Knowledge alone is dense with consciousness. That is thus said to be the Supreme Being as the all-consciousness. Moreover, since it is also the cause of the creation of the universe, he argues that it is the origin of the universe. If, however, the Brahman thus existing is not known as I, then he argues that whatever is Brahman is Brahman. This means that whatever is Brahman is what you are. What is that Brahman? It is therefore argued that the Brahman-lingam is signified by the Brahman and the Vedas, and therefore it is illustrated. Where is that from? This means that it is peaceful, devoid of all reactions, and cannot be directly expressed.

26.word_for_word: किं च, यत् स-विशेषं वस्तु, तत्र वयं प्रभवामः, त्वयि तु सर्व-विशेषातीते न कस्यापि प्रभुत्वं, किं तु त्वम् एव सर्व-प्रभुर् इति ज्ञप्ति-मात्रत्वं विवृण्वन् स्तौति---काल इति । — Moreover, in that which is that particular thing, we are able to do so, but in You, beyond all particulars, no one has dominion, but You are the Lord of all, explaining only the knowledge that You are the Lord of all, he praises, saying, Time.; कालः क्षोभकः । — Time is disturbing.; कर्म निमित्तम् । — The cause of action.; तद् एव फलाभिमुखम् अभिव्यक्तं दैवम् । — That is the expressed destiny of the fruit-oriented.; स्वभावस् तत्-संस्कारः । — Nature is that-culture.; जीवस् तद्वान् । — Jivas tadvan.; द्रव्यं भूत-सूक्ष्माणि । — Matter is the subtleties of beings.; क्षेत्रं प्रकृतिः । — The field is nature.; प्राणः सूत्रम् । — Prana is the formula.; आत्मा अहङ्कारः । — The soul is the ego.; विकार एकादशेन्द्रियाणि, महा-भूतानि चेति षोडशकः । — The sixteenth is the transformation of the eleven senses and the great beings.; तत्-सङ्घातो देहः । — That-assembly is the body.; तस्य च बीज-रोहवत् प्रवाहः, रोहोऽङ्कुरः, देहाद् बीज-रूपं कर्म । — Its flow is like the seed-root, the root is the sprout, and the seed-like action is from the body.; ततोऽङ्कुर-रूपो देहः, ततः पुनर् एवम् इति प्रवाहः । — Then the body in the form of a sprout, and then again the flow.; तं त्वां निषेधावधि-भूतं प्रपद्ये भजे इति ॥२६॥ — I surrender to You who are the limit of forbiddenness and worship You.
26.translation: Moreover, in that which is that particular thing, we are able to do so, but in You, beyond all particulars, no one has dominion, but You are the Lord of all, explaining only the knowledge that You are the Lord of all, he praises, saying, Time. Time is disturbing. The cause of action. That is the expressed destiny of the fruit-oriented. Nature is that-culture. Jivas tadvan. Matter is the subtleties of beings. The field is nature. Prana is the formula. The soul is the ego. The sixteenth is the transformation of the eleven senses and the great beings. That-assembly is the body. Its flow is like the seed-root, the root is the sprout, and the seed-like action is from the body. Then the body in the form of a sprout, and then again the flow. I surrender to You who are the limit of forbiddenness and worship You.

27.word_for_word: ननु देवकी-तनयस्य मे कथम् एवं-भूतत्वम् ? — How then can I, the son of Devakī, become such a being?; तत्राह---नाना-भावैर् इति । — There he says, by various means.; सर्वोपाधि-विनिर्मुक्तम् एव त्वं यथा लीलया स्वीकृतैर् मत्स्याद्य्-अवतारैर् देवान् बिभर्षि पालयसि । — You are free from all titles, just as you carry and protect the demigods in the incarnations of fish and others that you have playfully accepted.; तद्-अर्थं लोक-सेतून् वर्णाश्रम-धर्मान् । — For that purpose, the bridges of the world and the religions of the varṇas and āśramas are established.; तद्-अर्थं तद्-अनुष्ठातॄन् साधून् तद् अङ्गत्वेन उन्मार्गान् दैत्यादीन् हंसि संहरसि । — For that purpose, you kill and destroy the saintly persons who practice it, and as part of it, you destroy the deviant demons and others.; एवम् एतद् अपि ते तव जन्म भूमेर् भार-हरणाय । — So this is also your birth to relieve the burden of the earth.; लीलावतारोऽयं न कस्यापि त्वं तनय इत्य् अर्थः ॥२७॥ — This is an incarnation of pastimes, meaning that you are not the son of anyone.
27.translation: How then can I, the son of Devakī, become such a being? There he says, by various means. You are free from all titles, just as you carry and protect the demigods in the incarnations of fish and others that you have playfully accepted. For that purpose, the bridges of the world and the religions of the varṇas and āśramas are established. For that purpose, you kill and destroy the saintly persons who practice it, and as part of it, you destroy the deviant demons and others. So this is also your birth to relieve the burden of the earth. This is an incarnation of pastimes, meaning that you are not the son of anyone.

28.word_for_word: अतोऽज्ञानतस् त्वद् अभिभवे प्रवृत्तं मां तप्तं रक्षेत्य् आशयेनाह---तप्तोऽहम् इति । — Therefore, in the hope that You will protect me from the torment I have engaged in attacking You out of ignorance, He says, “I am tormented.”; ते तेजसा त्वत्-सृष्टेन ज्वरेण शान्तोग्रेण शीत-ज्वरेण । — They are struck by the fever you have created by your effulgence, by the calmness of the cold fever.; पर-सन्तापकस्य युक्त एव ताप इति चेद् अत आह---तावद् इति । — If it is said that the heat of the tormentor of others is justified, then he argues that it is so.; सेवायां प्रवृत्तानाम् अनुचित इति भावः ॥२८॥ — This means that it is not appropriate for those engaged in service.
28.translation: Therefore, in the hope that You will protect me from the torment I have engaged in attacking You out of ignorance, He says, “I am tormented.” They are struck by the fever you have created by your effulgence, by the calmness of the cold fever. If it is said that the heat of the tormentor of others is justified, then he argues that it is so. This means that it is not appropriate for those engaged in service.

29.word_for_word: हे त्रि-शिरः, व्येतु अपयातु । — O three-headed, let it pass.; मद्-आज्ञापालकः सन् सुखं विचर । — Be obedient to My commands and walk happily.; कासावाज्ञा ताम् आह---य इति । — The command of the cough told her, "Ya.; नौ आवयोर् इमं संवादं यः स्मरेत् तस्य त्वत् त्वत्तो न भयं भवेत् । — Whoever remembers this conversation between us will have no fear of you.; त्वया भयं नोत्पादनीयम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥२९-३३॥ — This means that you should not induce fear.29-3
29.translation: O three-headed, let it pass. Be obedient to My commands and walk happily. The command of the cough told her, "Ya. Whoever remembers this conversation between us will have no fear of you. This means that you should not induce fear.29-3

33.word_for_word: भक्त-रक्षणार्थं श्री-रुद्रो भगवन्तं स्तौति, त्वं हीति । — Lord Śrī Rudra praises the Lord for protecting His devotees, saying, “You are the Lord.”; अयम् अर्थः, त्वाम् अज्ञात्वायं युध्यत इति न चित्रम् । — This means that it is not surprising that he is fighting without knowing you.; यतस् त्वं वाङ्-मये ब्रह्मण्य् अपि गूढं ब्रह्म अभिधाविषयत्वात् । — Because you are the subject of the name, the Brahman is hidden even in the Brahman in the form of speech.; कुतः । — Where is it from?; परं ज्योतिः । — The Supreme Light.; ज्योतिषाम् अपि प्रकाशकत्वाद् अविषय इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that even the lights are non-objective because they are illuminating.; कथं तर्हि प्रतीतिर् अत आह---यम् इति । — How, then, is perception?; अमलात्मनां स्वतः प्रकाशसे इत्य् अर्थः ॥३३॥ — This means that You automatically illuminate the immaculate souls.
33.translation: Lord Śrī Rudra praises the Lord for protecting His devotees, saying, “You are the Lord.” This means that it is not surprising that he is fighting without knowing you. Because you are the subject of the name, the Brahman is hidden even in the Brahman in the form of speech. Where is it from? The Supreme Light. This means that even the lights are non-objective because they are illuminating. How, then, is perception? This means that You automatically illuminate the immaculate souls.

34.word_for_word: भक्त-रक्षणार्थं श्री-रुद्रो भगवन्तं स्तौति । — Lord Śrī Rudra praises the Lord for protecting His devotees.; त्वं हीति । — You’re the one.; अयम् अर्थः । — This is the meaning.; त्वाम् अज्ञात्वायं युध्यत इति न चित्रम् । — It’s no wonder he’s fighting without knowing you.; यतस् त्वं वाङ्मये ब्रह्मण्य् अपि गूढं ब्रह्म अभिधाविषयत्वात् । — Because You are the subject of the Abhidha, the Absolute Truth is hidden even in the verbal Absolute Truth.; कुतः । — Where is it from?; परं ज्योतिः ज्योतिषाम् अपि प्रकाशकत्वाद् अविषय इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the Supreme Light is non-objective because it is the illuminator of all lights.; कथं तर्हि प्रतीतिरत आह । — How, then, is it that the perceiver argues?; यम् इति । — Yam is the name.; अमलात्मनां स्वतः प्रकाशस इत्य् अर्थः ॥३४॥ — This means that You automatically illuminate the immaculate souls.
34.translation: Lord Śrī Rudra praises the Lord for protecting His devotees. You’re the one. This is the meaning. It’s no wonder he’s fighting without knowing you. Because You are the subject of the Abhidha, the Absolute Truth is hidden even in the verbal Absolute Truth. Where is it from? This means that the Supreme Light is non-objective because it is the illuminator of all lights. How, then, is it that the perceiver argues? Yam is the name. This means that You automatically illuminate the immaculate souls.

35.word_for_word: आस्तां तवन् निर्गुणस्य तव ज्ञानं लीलयाधिष्ठितस् त्वया यो विराड्-विग्रहः सोऽपि न ज्ञायते उदुम्बर-फलान्तर्-वर्तिम् अशकैर् इवोदुम्बर-फलम् इत्य् आशयेन विराड्-रूपेण स्तौति द्वाभ्याम्, नाभिर् इति । — Let there be Your knowledge of the transcendental, and the form of the Cosmic Being, whom You have playfully possessed, is not known.; यस्य नभ-आदयो नभ्य्-आद्य्-अवयवाः स भवण् लोक-कल्पः पुरुष इत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः । — The consequence of the answer is that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whose components are the sky and the sky, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; नभो यस्य नाभिः । — The sky is the navel of the universe.; अग्निर् मुखम् अम्बु रेतः । — Fire is the mouth, water is the semen.; द्यौः शीर्षम् । — The sky is the top.; आशा दिशः श्रुतिः श्रवणेन्द्रियम् । — Hope is the direction, hearing is the sense of hearing.; उर्वी अङ्घ्रिः । — Urvi Anghri.; चन्द्रो मनः । — The moon is the mind.; अर्को दृक् । — Arco view.; अहं शिव आत्माहङ्कारः । — I am Shiva, the Self-Ego.; समुद्रो जठरम् । — The sea is the stomach.; इन्द्रो भुजा बाहुः । — Indra is the arm and the arm.; इन्द्रादयो लोक-पाला बाहव इत्य् अर्थः ॥३५॥ — This means that Indra and others are the arms of the guardians of the worlds.
35.translation: Let there be Your knowledge of the transcendental, and the form of the Cosmic Being, whom You have playfully possessed, is not known. The consequence of the answer is that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whose components are the sky and the sky, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The sky is the navel of the universe. Fire is the mouth, water is the semen. The sky is the top. Hope is the direction, hearing is the sense of hearing. Urvi Anghri. The moon is the mind. Arco view. I am Shiva, the Self-Ego. The sea is the stomach. Indra is the arm and the arm. This means that Indra and others are the arms of the guardians of the worlds.

36.word_for_word: ओषधयो रोमाणि । — Herbs are hairs.; यच्-छब्दावृत्तिः स्पष्टतार्था । — The inversion of the word yach means clarity.; अम्बु-वाहाः केशाः । — Water-bearing hair.; विरिञ्चो धिषणा बुद्धिः । — Brahma is the intelligence of the mind.; प्रजा-पतिर् विसर्गो मेढ्रम् । — The husband of the people is the discharge of the genitals.; धर्मो हृदयम् । — Religion is the heart.; लोकैः कल्प्यतेऽवकल्प्यत इति लोक-कल्पः ॥३६॥ — It is conceived by the worlds and is not conceived, that is, the world-conception.
36.translation: Herbs are hairs. The inversion of the word yach means clarity. Water-bearing hair. Brahma is the intelligence of the mind. The husband of the people is the discharge of the genitals. Religion is the heart. It is conceived by the worlds and is not conceived, that is, the world-conception.

37.word_for_word: ननु तत्त्वतः प्रादेशिक-शरीरस्य कथं नभोनाभित्वादीत्य् अत आह---तवेति । — If so, how can the regional body in fact be from the sky?; हे अकुण्ठ-धामन्न् अप्रच्युत-स्वरूप, भवायाभ्युदयाय । — O Akuntha-dhamann, the unfailing form, for the prosperity of your being.; न केवलम् एतावत् किन्त्व् अस्मद्-अनुग्रहार्थम् अपीत्य् आह---वयं चेति । — Not only so much, but also for our sake, he argues, and for our sake.; सर्वे लोक-पालास् त्वया पालिताः सप्तापि भुवनानि पालयाम इति ॥३७॥ — All the rulers of the worlds are ruled by you and we rule the seven worlds.
37.translation: If so, how can the regional body in fact be from the sky? O Akuntha-dhamann, the unfailing form, for the prosperity of your being. Not only so much, but also for our sake, he argues, and for our sake. All the rulers of the worlds are ruled by you and we rule the seven worlds.

38.word_for_word: ननु यदि विभवयितारो यूयं विभाव्यानि च भुवनानि सन्ति तर्हि कथम् उक्तं त्वं हि ब्रह्मेति । — If, indeed, You are the creators of the universe and the universes that can be imagined, how can it be said that You are the Supreme Absolute Truth?; न हि ब्रह्मत्वे मम सजातीय-विजातीय-भेदः सम्भवतीत्य् अत आह---त्वम् इति । — For in my being Brahman there is no distinction between homogeneous and heterogeneous.; एकः सजातीय-भेद-रहितः । — One without homogeneous differences.; कुतः । — Where is it from?; आद्यः पुरुषः पुरुषाणाम् अवस्था-त्रय-वताम् आद्यः प्रकृति-भूतः पुरुषः । — The first person is the first of the three states of men, and the first person is the nature of the person.; कुतः । — Where is it from?; तुरीयः । — The fourth.; शुद्ध इत्य् अर्थः । — It means pure.; तद् अपि कुतः । — Where is that, too?; स्व-दृक् स्व-प्रकाश-ज्ञान-रूपः । — The self-seeing is the form of self-light and knowledge.; शुद्धाद् एव ह्य् उपाधि-योगाज् जीवा जायन्ते । — It is from the pure that the living entities are born from the combination of the titles.; "यथाग्नेः क्षुद्रा विस्फुलिङ्गा व्युच्चरन्त्य् एवम् एवास्माद् आत्मनः सर्व एव आत्मानो व्युच्चरन्ति" इति श्रुतेः । — "As the tiny sparks of fire emanate, so all the souls emanate from this Self," says the scripture.; अतः सजातीय-रहितः । — Therefore, homogeneous-free.; किं च अद्वितीयो विजातीय-रहितोऽपि । — What is more, he is unique and devoid of species?; कुतः । — Where is it from?; हेतुः सर्वस्य । — The cause of everything.; तथा स्वयं हेतु-रहितश् चेति । — and that he himself is without cause.; कथं तर्हि प्रति शरीरं जीव-भेदः प्रतीयतेऽत आह---प्रतीयस इति । — How, then, is the difference between the living entities perceived per body?; सर्व-गुण-प्रसिद्ध्यै सर्व-विषय-प्रकाशनाय ॥३८॥ — For the perfection of all virtues and for the illumination of all subjects.
38.translation: If, indeed, You are the creators of the universe and the universes that can be imagined, how can it be said that You are the Supreme Absolute Truth? For in my being Brahman there is no distinction between homogeneous and heterogeneous. One without homogeneous differences. Where is it from? The first person is the first of the three states of men, and the first person is the nature of the person. Where is it from? The fourth. It means pure. Where is that, too? The self-seeing is the form of self-light and knowledge. It is from the pure that the living entities are born from the combination of the titles. "As the tiny sparks of fire emanate, so all the souls emanate from this Self," says the scripture. Therefore, homogeneous-free. What is more, he is unique and devoid of species? Where is it from? The cause of everything. and that he himself is without cause. How, then, is the difference between the living entities perceived per body? For the perfection of all virtues and for the illumination of all subjects.

39.word_for_word: तर्हि किम् अहम् एवं संसारीत्य् उच्यते, न हि न हीति सदृष्टान्तम् आह---यथैवेति । — Is it, then, said that I am thus worldly?; हे भूमन्, स्वया छायया मेघ-लक्षणया पर-दृष्ट्या पिहितश् छादितोऽपि सूर्यश् छायां मेघं च रूपाणि च मेघान्तरितान् घटादीन् अपि सञ्चकास्ति प्रकाशयति । — O lord of the earth, even though the sun is covered by its own shadow, which is characteristic of clouds, it still illuminates the shadows, the clouds, the forms, the clouds and the clouds.; एवं गुणेनाहङ्कारेण स्व-कार्येण जीवावरकेण तद्-दृष्ट्या पिहितोऽपि गुणान् सत्त्वादीन् उपाधीन् गुणिनश् चोपहितान् जीवान् अपि चकास्ति । — Thus, although the ego, which is the cover of the living entity, is covered by the modes of nature and its own work, it still shines through the modes of nature, the modes of goodness and other titles, and the living entities who are covered by the modes of nature.; आत्म-प्रदीपः स्व-प्रकाशः । — The self-lamp is self-light.; अतः सर्व-साक्षिणस् तव न संसार इत्य् अर्थः ॥३९॥ — Therefore, this means that the world is not Your witness of all.
39.translation: Is it, then, said that I am thus worldly? O lord of the earth, even though the sun is covered by its own shadow, which is characteristic of clouds, it still illuminates the shadows, the clouds, the forms, the clouds and the clouds. Thus, although the ego, which is the cover of the living entity, is covered by the modes of nature and its own work, it still shines through the modes of nature, the modes of goodness and other titles, and the living entities who are covered by the modes of nature. The self-lamp is self-light. Therefore, this means that the world is not Your witness of all.

40.word_for_word: किं च मायाश्रयस्यान्यान् मोहयतस् तव कुतः संसृतिर् इत्य् आशयेनाह---यन् मायेअति । — Moreover, since you are deluding others under the shelter of illusion, where is the source of your material existence?; पुत्रादिषु प्रसक्ताः । — They are attached to their sons and others.; वृजिनार्णवे दुःख-सागरे । — In the ocean of trouble, in the ocean of sorrow.; उन्मज्जन्ति देवादि---योनिषु, निमज्जन्ति स्थावरादिषु । — They are immersed in the wombs of the gods and others, and they are immersed in the beings and others.; तद् उक्तं वायवीये, "विपर्ययश् च भवति ब्रह्मत्व-स्थावरत्वयोः" इति ॥४०॥ — That is stated in the Vayaviya, "And there is a contradiction between being Brahman and being immovable.
40.translation: Moreover, since you are deluding others under the shelter of illusion, where is the source of your material existence? They are attached to their sons and others. In the ocean of trouble, in the ocean of sorrow. They are immersed in the wombs of the gods and others, and they are immersed in the beings and others. That is stated in the Vayaviya, "And there is a contradiction between being Brahman and being immovable.

41.word_for_word: एवं जीवेश्वर-व्यवस्थां निरूप्येदानीम् अभजन्तं निन्दति द्वभ्याम्---देव- इति । — Thus describing the system of the Lord of the living entities, he now condemns the worshiper in two ways: God.; देवेन त्वया कर्माध्यक्षेण दत्तं नृ-देहम् इमं लब्ध्वापि इति ॥४१॥ — Even though you have obtained this human body given to you by the god, the presiding deity of action,'
41.translation: Thus describing the system of the Lord of the living entities, he now condemns the worshiper in two ways: God. Even though you have obtained this human body given to you by the god, the presiding deity of action,'

42.word_for_word: शोच्यत्वे हेतुः---यस् त्वाम् इति । — The reason for being sorry is that you.; विपर्यया विपरीता अनात्माप्रियानीश्वरा ये इन्द्रियार्थाः पुत्रादयः, तद्-अर्थम् ॥४२॥ — The objects of the senses, such as sons, are the objects of the senses, which are opposed to the self and are not dear to the Lord, for that purpose.
42.translation: The reason for being sorry is that you. The objects of the senses, such as sons, are the objects of the senses, which are opposed to the self and are not dear to the Lord, for that purpose.

43.word_for_word: अहम् अन्ये च शुद्ध-मनसस् त्वाम् एव प्राप्ता इत्य् आह---अहम् इति ॥४३॥ — I and others of pure mind have attained You alone, he said, "I am.
43.translation: I and others of pure mind have attained You alone, he said, "I am.

44.word_for_word: भगवतो भजनीयत्वे हेतून् वदंस् तद्-भक्तिं प्रार्थयते, तं त्वेति । — He explains the reasons why the Lord is worthy of worship and prays for His devotion, saying, “You are Him.”; समत्वे हेतुः, प्रशान्तम् इति । — The reason for equality is that it is calm.; सु-सेव्यत्वम् आह---सुहृद्-आत्म-दैवं सुहृद्-बुद्धि-प्रवर्तकत्वात्, आत्मा च सर्वात्मकत्वात्, एवं-भूतं दैवम् ईश्वरं त्वाम् । — He argues that being well-served is the destiny of the friend and the self, since the friend is the initiator of the intellect, and the soul is all-pervading, and thus the destiny of the self is God.; न चान्यो भजनीयोऽस्तीत्य् आह---अनन्यम् एकं समानासमान-जातीय-रहितम् । — He argues that there is no other to be worshipped, except the One, without the same or unequal race.; तत् कुतः । — Where is that from?; जगताम् आत्मनां च केतम् अधिष्ठानम् ॥४४॥ — What is the abode of the worlds and of the souls?
44.translation: He explains the reasons why the Lord is worthy of worship and prays for His devotion, saying, “You are Him.” The reason for equality is that it is calm. He argues that being well-served is the destiny of the friend and the self, since the friend is the initiator of the intellect, and the soul is all-pervading, and thus the destiny of the self is God. He argues that there is no other to be worshipped, except the One, without the same or unequal race. Where is that from? What is the abode of the worlds and of the souls?

45.word_for_word: स्वयं भक्तिम् आशास्य स्व-भक्तस्याभीष्टम् आशास् ते, अयम् इति । — He Himself hopes for devotion, and He hopes for the desire of His devotee, saying, “This is it.”; दैत्य-पतौ प्रह्रादे ॥४५-४६॥ — Prahlada, the lord of the demons.45-4
45.translation: He Himself hopes for devotion, and He hopes for the desire of His devotee, saying, “This is it.” Prahlada, the lord of the demons.45-4

47.word_for_word: वैरोच-निर्बलिर् मद्-भक्तस् तत् सुतत्वाद् अवध्यस् तावत् । — Vairoca, who is devoted to Me, is immortal because he is his son.; किं च प्रह्रादायेति । — What about Prahlada?; अन्वयो वंशः ॥४७॥ — The consequence is the lineage.
47.translation: Vairoca, who is devoted to Me, is immortal because he is his son. What about Prahlada? The consequence is the lineage.

48.word_for_word: तर्हि किम् इत्य् एवं कृतं तत्राह---दर्पोपशमनायेति ॥४८॥ — Then what is it that has been done in this way?
48.translation: Then what is it that has been done in this way?

49.word_for_word: अनुगृह्णाति, चत्वार इति ॥४९॥ — He is gracious, four, and so on.
49.translation: He is gracious, four, and so on.

50.word_for_word: सह वध्वा उषया ॥५०॥ — with the bride Usha.

51.word_for_word: रुद्रानुमोदित इति तद् अभिप्रेतस्यैव बाण-भुज-भङ्गस्य कृतत्वात् ॥५१॥ — It was approved by Lord Rudra, since he had broken the arm of Bāṇa, who had intended to do so.
51.translation: It was approved by Lord Rudra, since he had broken the arm of Bāṇa, who had intended to do so.

52.word_for_word: पौरादिभिर् अभ्युद्यतोऽभिमुखम् आगत्य सत्-कृतः ॥५२-५३॥ — The citizens and others greeted him and honored him as he approached them.
52.translation: The citizens and others greeted him and honored him as he approached them.
